title: 第23章 次元生物袭击第24章 合伙人
lines: 第23章次元生物袭击
车里车外，警报声同时响起。
头顶天空城市防御瞬息间升起，如一张巨大无匹的网，将整座城笼罩起来。
可问题是，这一次，次元空间刷在城里了！
出不去了！
继续在天上飞，那就是活靶子！
白牧野瞬间抓过方向舵，直接转为人工操作，向下一压，这辆多年的老爷车如同失重般向下坠落。
正滔滔不绝的姚谦直接闭嘴，脸色有些苍白，一把抓住头顶的把手，同时惊恐的看向白牧野。
白牧野脸色也十分凝重，次元生物入侵，他也是第一次遇见。
但这种情况对百城来说，不是什么稀罕事。
一年总会发生几十起。
而且毫无任何规律可言，有时候接连出现，有时候一连很多天都不会出现。
关键是这种事儿几乎都发生在城外，很少会出现在城里！
轰隆！
就在白牧野操纵老爷车下降的一瞬间，身边一座来不及开启防御的摩天大楼直接被撞出一个大窟窿。
接着，一道巨大的白色身影，足有十几米高，从那窟窿里面跳出来，嘶吼咆哮着，向着几十米高的地面落去。
白牧野咬着牙，拼命操作着这辆老爷车落在地上，冲着脸色苍白的姚谦喊道：“快出去！”
姚谦手忙脚乱解开安全带，连滚带爬的跑出去。
白牧野刚刚离开老爷车，就听见一声轰然巨响，那个白色的庞然大物重重落下，一脚踩在他的老爷车上。
车子当场被踩得稀巴烂，几乎成照片了！
白牧野完全来不及心疼自己的车，朝着远处拼命跑去。
就在这时，一道炫目光芒，自不远处亮起。
那是一道剑气，狠狠劈向这头白色的庞然大物！
白色怪物那巨大的身躯上瞬间便出现了一道鲜红血痕，大量鲜血顺着伤口流淌出来，一下子染红了半边身子。
嗷！
白色怪物暴怒，咆哮着抓起一辆车，狠狠砸向那边一个拎着剑的中年人。
那人猛的一跳，想要跳开，谁知那白色怪物只是虚晃一枪！
那辆在它手中如同玩具的车并没有扔出去。
中年人被狠狠晃了一下。
身子收不住的跳向一旁。
直到这一刻，白色怪物才将手中那辆车狠狠地砸了出来。
太狡猾了！
中年人躲不开了！
飞车狠狠砸在他肩上，一条手臂被砸得粉碎。
白牧野身体中轰然涌起一股热血，直冲头顶，低吼一声，就要朝那边冲过去。
却被身边姚谦一把抓住他的手臂，那只手如同钳子一般，力量巨大无比。
“别动！”
姚谦发出一声低吼，五级灵战士的实力在这一刻终于显现出来。
“没救了！”
content_en:
Chapter 23 Dimensional Creature Attack
Alarms sounded simultaneously inside and outside the car.
The city defenses in the sky above the sky rose instantly, like a huge and unparalleled net, covering the entire city.
But the problem is, this time, the dimensional space is in the city!
Can't get out!
If you continue to fly in the sky, you will be a living target!
Bai Muye instantly grabbed the rudder, switched it directly to manual operation, and pressed down. The old car fell downwards as if it were weightless.
Yao Qian, who was talking endlessly, immediately shut up, his face turned pale, he grabbed the handle above his head and looked at Bai Muye in horror.
Bai Muye's face was also very solemn. This was the first time he had encountered the invasion of dimensional creatures.
But this situation is not uncommon for Baicheng.
There are always dozens of incidents a year.
And there is no pattern at all. Sometimes they appear one after another, and sometimes they don't appear for many days in a row.
The key is that this kind of thing almost always happens outside the city and rarely happens in the city!
Boom!
The moment Bai Muye controlled the classic car to descend, a skyscraper next to him that had no time to activate its defense was directly knocked out of a large hole.
Then, a huge white figure, more than ten meters high, jumped out of the hole, roared, and fell towards the ground dozens of meters high.
Bai Muye gritted his teeth and desperately maneuvered the classic car to the ground, shouting at the pale Yao Qian: "Get out quickly!"
Yao Qian hurriedly unbuckled his seat belt and ran out rolling and crawling.
Just as Bai Muye left the classic car, he heard a loud bang, and the huge white thing fell heavily and stepped on his classic car.
The car was trampled to pieces on the spot, almost like a photo!
Bai Muye had no time to feel sorry for his car and ran as fast as he could into the distance.
At this moment, a dazzling light lit up not far away.
It was a sword energy that struck hard at this huge white beast!
A bright red bloodstain instantly appeared on the huge body of the white monster. A large amount of blood flowed out from the wound, dyeing half of its body red at once.
Ouch!
The white monster was furious, roared, grabbed a car, and slammed it at a middle-aged man holding a sword over there.
The man jumped violently and tried to jump away, but the white monster just made a feint!
The car, which looked like a toy in its hands, was not thrown away.
The middle-aged man was shaken hard.
Unable to control himself, he jumped to the side.
It wasn't until this moment that the white monster smashed the car out of his hand.
So cunning!
Middle-aged people can’t escape!
The flying car hit him hard on the shoulder, and one arm was smashed to pieces.
Bai Muye's body suddenly surged with hot blood, rushing straight to the top of his head. With a low roar, he was about to rush over there.
But Yao Qian next to him grabbed his arm. His hand was like a pliers, with immense power.
"Don't move!"
Yao Qian let out a low roar, and the strength of the fifth-level spiritual warrior was finally revealed at this moment.
"It's hopeless!"
